verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת־הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «لَا تُهْلِكْ». مُذَهَّبَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ لَمَّا أَرْسَلَ شَاوُلُ وَرَاقَبُوا ٱلْبَيْتَ لِيَقْتُلُوهُ.
verses.en: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David; Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.ar: أَنْقِذْنِي مِنْ أَعْدَائِي يَا إِلَهِي. مِنْ مُقَاوِمِيَّ ٱحْمِنِي.
verses.en: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; set me on high from them that rise up against me.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.web: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

verses.he: הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הֹושִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: نَجِّنِي مِنْ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ، وَمِنْ رِجَالِ ٱلدِّمَاءِ خَلِّصْنِي،
verses.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from the men of blood.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.web: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

verses.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָֽרְב֡וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣י עַזִ֑ים לֹא־פִשְׁעִ֖י וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִ֣י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ يَكْمِنُونَ لِنَفْسِي. ٱلْأَقْوِيَاءُ يَجْتَمِعُونَ عَلَيَّ، لَا لِإِثْمِي وَلَا لِخَطِيَّتِي يَارَبُّ.
verses.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; the impudent gather themselves together against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
verses.kjv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not [for] my transgression, nor [for] my sin, O LORD.
verses.web: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

verses.he: בְּֽלִי־עָ֭וֹן יְרוּצ֣וּן וְיִכֹּונָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵה׃
verses.ar: بِلَا إِثْمٍ مِنِّي يَجْرُونَ وَيُعِدُّونَ أَنْفُسَهُمُ. ٱسْتَيْقِظْ إِلَى لِقَائِي وَٱنْظُرْ!
verses.en: Without my fault, they run and prepare themselves; awake Thou to help me, and behold.
verses.kjv: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.web: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָֽה־אֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ צְבָאֹ֡ות אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָה לִפְקֹ֥ד כָּֽל־הַגֹּויִ֑ם אַל־תָּחֹ֨ן כָּל־בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: وَأَنْتَ يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ، إِلَهَ إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱنْتَبِهْ لِتُطَالِبَ كُلَّ ٱلْأُمَمِ. كُلَّ غَادِرٍ أَثِيمٍ لَا تَرْحَمْ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, arouse Thyself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to any iniquitous traitors. Selah
verses.kjv: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.web: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

verses.he: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיסֹ֥ובְבוּ עִֽיר׃
verses.ar: يَعُودُونَ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ، يَهِرُّونَ مِثْلَ ٱلْكَلْبِ، وَيَدُورُونَ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ.
verses.en: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.kjv: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.web: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֤ה ׀ יַבִּ֘יע֤וּן בְּפִיהֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבֹות בְּשִׂפְתֹותֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי־מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.ar: هُوَذَا يُبِقُّونَ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ. سُيُوفٌ فِي شِفَاهِهِمْ. لِأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ: «مَنْ سَامِعٌ؟».
verses.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: 'For who doth hear?'
verses.kjv: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords [are] in their lips: for who, [say they], doth hear?
verses.web: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ فَتَضْحَكُ بِهِمْ. تَسْتَهْزِئُ بِجَمِيعِ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: But Thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt have all the nations in derision.
verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.web: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

verses.ar: مِنْ قُوَّتِهِ، إِلَيْكَ أَلْتَجِئُ، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ مَلْجَإِي.
verses.en: Because of his strength, I will wait for Thee; for God is my high tower.
verses.kjv: [Because of] his strength will I wait upon thee: for God [is] my defence.
verses.web: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

verses.ar: إِلَهِي رَحْمَتُهُ تَتَقَدَّمُنِي. ٱللهُ يُرِينِي بِأَعْدَائِي.
verses.en: The God of my mercy will come to meet me; God will let me gaze upon mine adversaries.
verses.kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.
verses.web: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

verses.he: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵ֤ם ׀ פֶּֽן־יִשְׁכְּח֬וּ עַמִּ֗י הֲנִיעֵ֣מֹו בְ֭חֵילְךָ וְהֹורִידֵ֑מֹו מָֽגִנֵּ֣נוּ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.ar: لَا تَقْتُلْهُمْ لِئَلَّا يَنْسَى شَعْبِي. تَيِّهْهُمْ بِقُوَّتِكَ وَأَهْبِطْهُمْ يَارَبُّ تُرْسَنَا.
verses.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget, make them wander to and fro by Thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.kjv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.web: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

verses.he: חַטַּאת־פִּ֗ימֹו דְּֽבַר־שְׂפָ֫תֵ֥ימֹו וְיִלָּכְד֥וּ בִגְאֹונָ֑ם וּמֵאָלָ֖ה וּמִכַּ֣חַשׁ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: خَطِيَّةُ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ هِيَ كَلَامُ شِفَاهِهِمْ. وَلْيُؤْخَذُوا بِكِبْرِيَائِهِمْ، وَمِنَ ٱللَّعْنَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْكَذِبِ ٱلَّذِي يُحَدِّثُونَ بِهِ.
verses.en: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride, and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.kjv: [For] the sin of their mouth [and] the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying [which] they speak.
verses.web: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

verses.he: כַּלֵּ֥ה בְחֵמָה֮ כַּלֵּ֪ה וְֽאֵ֫ינֵ֥מֹו וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־אֱ֭לֹהִים מֹשֵׁ֣ל בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב לְאַפְסֵ֖י הָאָ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَفْنِ، بِحَنَقٍ أَفْنِ، وَلَا يَكُونُوا، وَلْيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ ٱللهَ مُتَسَلِّطٌ فِي يَعْقُوبَ إِلَى أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they be no more; and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah
verses.kjv: Consume [them] in wrath, consume [them], that they [may] not [be:] and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.web: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.he: וְיָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיסֹ֥ובְבוּ עִֽיר׃
verses.ar: وَيَعُودُونَ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ. يَهِرُّونَ مِثْلَ ٱلْكَلْبِ، وَيَدُورُونَ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ.
verses.en: And they return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city;
verses.kjv: And at evening let them return; [and] let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.web: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

verses.ar: هُمْ يَتِيهُونَ لِلْأَكْلِ. إِنْ لَمْ يَشْبَعُوا وَيَبِيتُوا.
verses.en: They wander up and down to devour, and tarry all night if they have not their fill.
verses.kjv: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.web: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּךָ֮ וַאֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַבֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לִ֑י וּ֝מָנֹ֗וס בְּיֹ֣ום צַר־לִֽי׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُغَنِّي بِقُوَّتِكَ، وَأُرَنِّمُ بِٱلْغَدَاةِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، لِأَنَّكَ كُنْتَ مَلْجَأً لِي، وَمَنَاصًا فِي يَوْمِ ضِيقِي.
verses.en: But as for me, I will sing of Thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of Thy mercy in the morning; for Thou hast been my high tower, and a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.kjv: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.web: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

verses.he: עֻ֭זִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֲזַמֵּ֑רָה כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י אֱלֹהֵ֥י חַסְדִּֽי׃
verses.ar: يَا قُوَّتِي لَكَ أُرَنِّمُ، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ مَلْجَإِي، إِلَهُ رَحْمَتِي.
verses.en: O my strength, unto Thee will I sing praises; for God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God [is] my defence, [and] the God of my mercy.
verses.web: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
